subject: Follow-up: Deployment mode & migration plan (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)

Subject: Quick follow-up & infra details (migration)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. As promised, attaching a quick infra snapshot (attached: Orion_infra-overview.pdf). A couple of clarifying points from our side to help qualify: 
- Current setup: self-hosted cluster (4x A100s) orchestrated via internal scheduler; we also have some endpoints on a third-party LLM API for burst traffic.
- Expected steady-state: ~3M tokens/day, peak 1.2k concurrent requests for chat flows; 95th p95 latency target ~300ms.

- Timeline: goal is to have a migration plan and pilot in the next 6–8 weeks.

What we need from Redwood: recommended deployment path (Hosted API pilot vs Dedicated vs Private VPC), migration gotchas for KV cache/warm-up and latency, and a rough cost/profile for Dedicated capacity.

Can we do a short follow-up next week to go over options? I copied Sam (platform lead) who will join the technical deep-dive.

Thanks —
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Alex / Sam —

Great to meet you both today — thanks for the infra snapshot; that’s very helpful. Below is a quick post-call recap + proposed next steps so we’re aligned on qualification and the right migration path.

Recap / qualification highlights:
- Traffic & SLOs: ~3M tokens/day, p95 latency target ~300ms, peaks ~1.2k concurrent — falls within patterns we typically handle with either Hosted API + caching optimizations or a Dedicated pool depending on consistent peak windows.
- Data sensitivity: PHI/PII in flight & at rest — Private VPC or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS required to meet compliance needs.
- Current infra: 4x A100 self-hosted + third-party API for bursts — migration will likely be staged: pilot on Hosted API -> Dedicated -> Private VPC (if/when required).
- Timeline: pilot in 6–8 weeks is feasible; Dedicated onboarding ~3–4 weeks after pilot acceptance; Private VPC/on-prem ~6–8 weeks depending on network/KMS approvals.

Potential migration paths (high-level):
1) Hosted API pilot (fastest): 2–4 week pilot to validate correctness, latency and prompts. We can enable prefix/KV caching and a temporary burst config to mimic your peak load.
2) Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity): recommended if you need predictable throughput and lower unit costs at scale. Includes autoscaling policies and isolation.
3) Private VPC / on-prem: for PHI/regulated workloads — customer-managed networking + KMS. Longer onboarding, but matches strict compliance needs.

Immediate next steps I propose:
- Technical deep-dive w/ Neha (Solutions Engineering) and your platform lead (Sam) to validate model choices, batching, and caching strategy. (Propose times: Wed 7/14 10–11am PT or Thu 7/15 2–3pm PT) — Calendly link below.
- I’ll loop in pricing/solutions to provide a Dedicated estimate and a PoC scope for a Hosted pilot.
- Deliverables: Redwood mutual action plan (MAP) + SOC2 summary + a Dedicated pricing ballpark.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Orion.pdf (draft MAP), SOC2_summary.pdf

If that plan sounds good I’ll schedule the deep-dive and include Neha & Vivek for capacity/pricing confirmations.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Thanks — if you can reply by EOD tomorrow I’ll synthesize and send next steps.

Subject: Next steps & pilot proposal (Hosted pilot -> Dedicated -> VPC)

Alex / Sam —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Per internal alignment (Neha & Vivek looped above), here are the confirmed next steps and a proposal to keep momentum: 

1) Hosted API pilot (4 weeks) — goal: validate correctness, p95 latency, and end-to-end prompts under a controlled traffic profile. Details:
   - Scope: 2 chat endpoints, 50k messages/day simulated ramp to match 30% of your peak traffic, enable prefix/KV caching, and request/response logging for evals.
   - Success criteria: p95 <= 350ms on pilot traffic, no regression in prompt outputs, and stable cost within projected budget.
   - Cost: pilot on Hosted API with usage caps; we can apply a promotional credit for first month.

2) Dedicated capacity (post-pilot) — preliminary guidance: based on your described load we recommend a Dedicated pool equivalent to 2 x large GPU instances (config and exact SKU TBD after the deep-dive). Ballpark monthly range: $12k–$28k depending on instance SKU and retention/KMS options. Vivek/Neha: please flag if a different sizing is needed.

3) Private VPC/on-prem (long term) — ETA: 6–8 weeks after contract + network approval. Includes customer-managed KMS/HSM and audit log forwarding.

Attachments included: Redwood_MAP_Orion.pdf (draft MAP with milestones), SOC2_summary.pdf, Dedicated_pricing_estimate.xlsx (ballpark).

Next actions for you:
- Please confirm pilot scope and which week you’d like to start (we can kick off as soon as 7/20).
- Confirm preferred time for the technical deep-dive if you want to go deeper on model config: Wed 7/14 10am PT or Thu 7/15 2pm PT.

Once you confirm the pilot start week we’ll: finalize MAP, open a pilot workspace, and provision temporary keys for validation.

Best,
